title: setup hook --scope user --harness codex refuses a CODEX_HOME outside the home folder
source: intended: setup hook for every harness (claude, codex, opencode, pi): one plan, one preview, one confirmation and one backup
intent: INTENDED behavior. User scope writes and backs up only under HOME, so a CODEX_HOME outside it is an environment error (exit 3) that names it, and nothing is written.
